messages:
alex: Vendor reached out proposing a consolidated press window for H100/H200 + MI300 + Gaudi. They want one announcement day. Partnership concern: staggered certs and marketplace SKU hygiene. Thoughts?
announce-bot: Vendor brief uploaded: https://vendor.example.com/partner-brief-v2 (contains SKU readiness matrix + embargo notes).
elaine: From SI perspective, integration kits for Gaudi are still in final validation. We could support early customers but not a wide GA.
priyam: Can we publish a compatibility matrix that explicitly marks which models are certified per SKU and which are "recommended fallback"? That helps SIs and customer comms.
tina: Agreed. Operationally, we should prepare two marketplace tag states: "announce-ready" and "preannounce-limited". Keep the SKU mapping strict to avoid customer confusion.
vendor-eng: Current vendor ETA: image tags for H100/H200/MI300 by Thursday COB. Gaudi driver certing may slip 48-72h. We'll send manifest with fallback hints.
jack: On the platform side, we'll need 1) routing policy for requested SKU fallthrough, 2) image tag pinning for Dedicated pools, 3) a canary runbook for the first 24h. I can draft the routing policy today.
maria: Public messaging recommendation: avoid hard ship dates. Use "available in limited regions" + "follow-up update with full SKU availability". That buys wiggle room for Gaudi.
priyam: For evals, I suggest a smoke suite: 3 workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings) x 100 prompts each on quantized variants. If regression > 5% accuracy drop, we hold. Who runs this?
jack: I'll provision a small canary cluster (H100 pool + MI300) and run the suite. ETA 36-48h after tags. Add a Gaudi slot if vendor drops drivers.
tina: Contingency plan: if Gaudi misses, we still proceed with announcement but mark Gaudi as "coming soon" and enable automatic fallbacks. Legal/PR needs embargo wording that allows a phased SKU reveal. I'll loop in legal.
vendor-eng: We'll embed fallback metadata in image manifests. Example manifest fragment we can include for routing automation:
```
"fallbacks": {
  "gaudi": ["mi300-quant", "h200-quant"],
  "h200": ["h100-quant"]
}
```
elaine: For SI partner deployments, we need a clear "early access" onboarding path for Gaudi customers, separate from marketplace GA. That will protect SLAs.
maria: Also recommend a staged press cadence: announce joint partnership + tech overview on day 0, then a technical deep-dive blog and regional SKU availability post a week later. Keeps messaging consistent.
alex: Action list: tina create tag-state map + draft embargo copy; priyam publish compatibility matrix; jack build canary + run smoke suite; vendor-eng deliver image tags + manifest by Thu COB; elaine draft SI early-access flow. Reconvene Friday morning to confirm. :thumbsup:
tina: Will post drafts to /docs/partners/ and ping legal.
vendor-eng: Noting risk: Gaudi driver QA may extend 72h. If it does, we'll update manifest and fallback lists immediately.
priyam: I'll start collecting test prompts. Expect initial matrix by EOD tomorrow.
jack: Canary infra request filed. ETA on cluster spin: 24h after tags.
maria: I'll sync with comms on the blog timeline and draft holding statements.
alex: Thanks all. If vendor PM gives firm dates, drop them here and we'll pivot.
